page-structure.evidence: A <section class='no-scrollbar'> element carries aria-roledescription='carousel' but has no accessible name (no aria-label/aria-labelledby) and no explicit role attribute. Without an accessible name, <section> maps to the generic role in Chrome, and WCAG 4.1.2 / axe 'aria-roledescription' flag aria-roledescription on a generic element as invalid — AT will not convey the custom description. The named DIV sibling (role='group' aria-label='Deals' aria-roledescription='carousel') is correctly formed. Title 'Pizza Delivery & Carryout, Pasta, Wings & More | Domino's' is descriptive (2.4.2 passes). Visible heading outline: H1 'Start your order' → H2 (deal sections) → H3 (deal subsections) → H2 (What's new, Browse Menu, footer) — hierarchy is coherent on desktop; duplicate headings at x:0,y:0 are collapsed responsive variants (height:0), not duplicates. Landmarks: header (sticky nav = banner), nav[aria-label=Main], main, footer = sufficient. Two unlabelled <header> elements present; the second is inside <section><main> so it does not create a second banner landmark in the AX tree. listStyleNone:12 — see grouping-and-reading-order.

grouping-and-reading-order.evidence: 12 <ul>/<ol> elements have list-style:none computed style without an explicit role='list'. Reading order from tabWalk (skip link first → nav → hero buttons → deals → browse menu links → footer) matches visual top-to-bottom, left-to-right order — 1.3.2 NOT REPRODUCED. No modal background hiding issue detected (privacy modal is zero-size, not currently open).

issues.evidence: <section class='no-scrollbar'> has aria-roledescription='carousel' without an accessible name or explicit role — aria-roledescription on a nameless generic element is invalid per WCAG 4.1.2.
12 <ul>/<ol> elements have list-style:none without role='list' — VoiceOver/Safari strips list semantics; item count not announced.

'Offer details' button click reveals an offer panel (SR announces 'heading, Offer Details, level 2') but focus does not move into the panel (focusMoved:false, focusMovedTo:null, dialogOpened:false). Keyboard users cannot reach the expanded deal content.

'Offer details' button reveals content but liveRegionChanged:false and liveMutations:[] — the panel open state is not announced as a live region update. Combined with no focus move, the activation result is not programmatically conveyed.
Browse Menu category links are in a <ul> with list-style:none and no role='list' — VoiceOver strips list semantics.

Footer and Browse Menu links (els 14, 15, 17, 18, 19) have computed outline:none and no box-shadow — computed styles suggest no focus indicator. Could not confirm via screenshot (all below fold, method:computed-only). Potential 2.4.7 concern across footer/body links.
